CloudSave.title: CloudSave
CloudSave.description: Cross-device cloud save snapshot for Infinite Gates storing global progress, settings, active session, chrono anchors, and save slots.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid.

deviceLabel.description: Human-readable name of the Android device that wrote this snapshot.

displayName.description: Optional Google account display name for sync diagnostics.

clientUpdatedAtMs.description: Client epoch timestamp in milliseconds used to determine latest save progress.

currentDoorId.description: Active or most recent door ID (1..14).

currentDoorName.description: Display name of the active or most recent door.

currentSceneId.description: Active or most recent scene identifier.

currentRoomName.description: Active or most recent room display title.

currentHp.description: Current or most recent HP value.

saveSlotCount.description: Count of populated manual and autosave slots.

progressData.description: Native Firestore Map representation of GlobalProgress.

settingsData.description: Native Firestore Map representation of GameSettings.

lastSessionData.description: Optional native Firestore Map representation of LastSessionData.

chronoAnchorsData.description: Native Firestore List of up to 3 ChronoAnchorData maps.

saveSlotsData.description: Native Firestore List of manual and autosave SaveSlotData maps.

updatedAt.description: Server-assigned last update timestamp via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/cloud_saves/{saveId}.description: User-scoped cloud save snapshots owned exclusively by the authenticated Google user.
